title: UX State Matrix Compiler
description: Validates state coverage for every screen: data-dependent screens must declare loading/success/empty/error states; error states must have recovery actions; network screens need offline handling; protected screens need unauthorized handling. Produces state-matrix-artifact.json.

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract state-matrix-spec.json from screen inventory, data dependencies, and API error contracts

pipeline.title: Structure
pipeline.description: Validate screen structure and state declarations

pipeline.title: State Coverage
pipeline.description: Validate completeness of state declarations across all screen types

pipeline.title: Recovery
pipeline.description: Validate recovery actions on all error states

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: state-matrix-spec.json exists with screens array; each screen has id and dataDependencies

gates.title: No Duplicate States
gates.description: Within each screen, each state type appears at most once

gates.title: Required States
gates.description: Data-dependent screens declare loading, success, empty, and error states

gates.title: Offline State
gates.description: Network-dependent screens declare an offline state or set offlineHandledGlobally: true

gates.title: Unauthorized State
gates.description: Auth-protected screens declare an unauthorized state or set unauthorizedHandledByGuard: true

gates.title: Partial State
gates.description: Paginated/optional-data screens declare a partial state

gates.title: Recovery Action
gates.description: Every error/offline/unauthorized state declares at least one recovery action

gates.title: No TODOs
gates.description: No TODO/FIXME/HACK/TBD in any spec file

gates.title: State Matrix Contract
gates.description: Full contract: version, unique ids, state objects have type

contracts.description: Structural requirements for all compiled UX state matrices

error_codes.UXS001: state-matrix-spec.json missing or invalid — screens array with id and dataDependencies required
error_codes.UXS002: Data-dependent screen missing required state — loading, success, empty, and error are all required
error_codes.UXS005: Error state has no recovery action and is not marked terminal
error_codes.UXS006: Duplicate state type within a single screen
error_codes.UXS008: TODO/FIXME/HACK/TBD found in spec file — indicates incomplete state coverage
error_codes.UXS009: State matrix contract violation — version missing, duplicate screen ids, or state objects without type
